# Jafza Traders Market

> Jafza Traders Market is a wholesale and retail trading hub in Sectors 7 and 8 of Jebel Ali Free Zone, Dubai, and the first phase of the wider Dubai Traders Market masterplan. Opened in 2022 as Yiwu Market, it spans about 200,000 square metres over two floors, with 1,600 showrooms backed by 324 customs-bonded warehouses. Each warehouse has its own loading dock, and showrooms are grouped by category across five atriums.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Jebel Ali, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2022

## MENASCO Scope

Jafza Traders Market is a hybrid retail and wholesale trading hub developed by DP World in Sectors 7 and 8 of Jebel Ali Free Zone, forming part of the wider Dubai Traders Market masterplan. Its first phase opened in 2022 as Yiwu Market, combining showrooms with warehouses served by dedicated loading docks. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the development.
